🤖 Gravity Falls Creator Trolls Sam Altman

Sam Altman shared a ChatGPT hack to connect the bot to family calendars and create daily podcasts about kids' interests and events.

Alex Hirsch, creator of Gravity Falls, replied suggesting it’s better to just talk to your kids instead.

📊@tech

Alibaba has introduced Qwen3.8-Max, a new AI model with 2.4 trillion parameters, which recently operated autonomously for 16 days. According to reports, the model completed 265 commits, 127 pull requests, and 151 issues during a continuous develop-test-repair-merge cycle.

Qwen3.8-Max’s operational cost is cited as 80% lower than GPT-5.6 Sol and 88% below Claude Fable 5 for output, with prices at $2 per million input tokens and $6 per million output tokens. For comparison, GPT-5.6 Sol lists $5/$30 and Claude Fable 5 lists $10/$50 for input/output tokens respectively.

The model demonstrates broad capabilities in coding, professional tasks, and computer-based work. Open weights for Qwen3.8-Max are expected next week.

🗣"AI will spark a Cambrian explosion of programming languages."

Boris Cherny, Head of Agentic Coding at Anthropic, says AI is accelerating innovation across software, just as it's already accelerating breakthroughs in fields like material discovery.

"Instead of converging on a single dominant programming language, AI may enable an explosion of new languages and entirely new ways of thinking about computing."
